title: Religious Court — Relations With the Larger Faith

entries.value: Schismatic — despised as potentially heretical by the hierarchy
Desultory — going through the motions with little genuine piety
Penitential — a punishment posting for clergy who erred elsewhere
Affable — courteous and cooperative with the bishop
Populist — focused on serving the poor lay believers
Scholarly — given to sophisticated theological debate
Mystical — conducting prayer, fasting, and visionary studies
Pioneering — a new missionary establishment in a pagan area
Zealous — full of fervent and demanding believers
Subverted — effectively controlled by a secular lord
Venerable — ancient, greatly honoured, set in its ways
Sectarian — a stronghold of one theological faction against another
